item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Should Refrain from Entering Starbucks... Pushing for Law to Punish Mockery of May 18" (정청래 “스벅 출입 자제해야…5·18 조롱 처벌법 추진”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Should Refrain from Entering Starbucks... Pushing for Law to Punish Mockery of May 18" (정청래 “스벅 출입 자제해야…5·18 조롱 처벌법 추진”)

<<>> On the 20th, Democratic Party Representative Jung Cheong-rae announced, in relation to Starbucks Korea's "May 18 Tank Day" event, a call to refrain from entering Starbucks and the push for legislation that would punish mockery of the May 18 Democratization Movement. ()

At the Central Election Countermeasure Committee meeting held in Yeoju, Gyeonggi Province, Representative Jung stated, "Like Germany, we need to create stronger laws that can punish those who mock or belittle the May 18 or democratization movements." (더불어민주당 정청래 대표가 스타벅스코리아의 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 이벤트와 관련, 스타벅스 출입 자제령을 내리고 5·18 민주화 운동 등을 조롱하면 처벌 받는 법안을 추진하겠다고 20일 밝혔다.)

He further added, "For those campaigning for the Democratic Party or candidates, entering Starbucks itself can give a very negative impression to the public," and suggested, "Refraining from entering Starbucks would align better with the public sentiment, wouldn't it?" (정 대표는 이날 경기 여주에서 열린 중앙선거대책위원회의에서 ”우리도 독일처럼 5.18이나 민주화 운동을 조롱하거나 폄훼하는 것에 대해서는 더 강력한 그런 처벌할 수 있는 법을 더 만들어야 되겠다”고 했다.)

Jung also questioned, "The scenes of mercilessly slaughtering and suppressing citizens with tanks—how can that be used for marketing?" and noted, "Don't our people suffer from mental stress and trauma whenever May 18 comes around?" (또 정 대표는 “민주당 선거운동을 하시는 분들이나 후보자들이 스타벅스를 출입하는 것 자체가 국민들에게 매우 안 좋은 인상을 줄 수 있다”며 “스타벅스 출입은 자제해 주시는 것이 국민 정서에 맞지 않을까”라고 했다.)

Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho wrote on his Facebook, "If just 13 days ago, the ruling and opposition parties had agreed on a constitutional amendment enshrining the May 18 spirit in the preamble, and if it had passed the National Assembly threshold, the heinous act like this famous coffee brand Starbucks' 'Tank Day' would have been unimaginable." (그러면서 정 대표는 “탱크로 시민들을 무자비하게 학살하고 진압하던 그 장면들, 그걸 어떻게 마케팅용으로 사용할 수 있을까”라며 “우리가 5·18 때만 되면 우리 국민들이 정신적인 스트레스와 트라우마를 갖고 있지 않나”라고 했다.)

Earlier, Democratic Party lawmakers also expressed their intention to boycott Starbucks. The previous day, Representative Bok Gi-wang posted on his social media a video of him throwing a disposable Starbucks plastic cup to the ground, along with the message, "Starbucks that insulted history—I won't drink it and ban bringing it in!" (정성호 법무부장관은 자신의 페이스북에 “불과 13일 전, 5·18 정신을 헌법 전문에 담는 개헌안에 여야가 합의했더라면, 국회 문턱을 넘었더라면 이번 유명 커피 브랜드 스타벅스의 ‘탱크데이’ 같은 패륜적 만행은 감히 꿈도 꿀 수 없었을 것”이라고 했다.)

Representative Oh Gi-hyung also wrote on his Facebook, "I gave up Starbucks today. I used to drink coffee at the Starbucks in front of the camp every morning, but after seeing the report on the May 18 Tank Day event, I didn't feel like going back. It seems hard to use it until there are sincere measures and changes." (앞서 민주당 의원들도 스타벅스 불매 의사를 표했다. 전날 복기왕 의원은 자신의 SNS에 “역사를 모욕한 스타벅스, 안 마시고 반입도 금지합니다!”라는 글과 함께 1회용 스타벅스 플라스틱 컵을 바닥에 던지는 영상을 올렸다.)

Previously, Starbucks came under suspicion for belittling the May 18 Democratization Movement through a promotional sale of goods called the "Tank Tumbler Set" on the 18th. Starbucks used marketing phrases like "Thump on the desk!" and "May 18 Tank Day," which drew criticism for evoking the police's remark during the Park Jong-cheol torture death case—"Thump the desk and he died with an 'uh'"—and the military's armored vehicles. (오기형 의원도 자신의 페이스북에 “오늘은 스타벅스를 재꼈다. 매일 아침 캠프 앞 스타벅스에서 커피를 마시곤 했지만, 5·18 탱크데이 행사 보도를 본 뒤 다시 들어갈 마음이 들지 않았다”며 “진정성 있는 조치와 변화가 있기 전까지 이용하기 어려울 것 같다”고 했다.)

In response, Chairman Chung Yong-jin of Shinsegae Group, the parent company of SCK Company which operates Starbucks, issued an apology on the 19th, stating, "Starbucks Korea conducted inappropriate marketing that should not have happened and cannot be tolerated," and "I bow my head in apology on behalf of the group." (앞서 스타벅스는 지난 18일 ‘탱크 텀블러 세트’라는 굿즈 판매 프로모션을 하면서 5·18 민주화 운동을 폄훼했다는 의혹을 받고 있다. 스타벅스는 마케팅 문구로 ‘책상에 탁!’ ‘5·18 탱크데이’를 사용했는데, 박종철 고문치사 사건 당시 경찰의 “책상을 탁 치니 억 하고 죽었다”는 발언과, 계엄군 장갑차를 연상시킨다는 지적이 나왔다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk says, "In Pyeongtaek B, if a single opposition candidate emerges, we must follow the public's mandate." Kim Yong-nam says, "The possibility is slim." (조국 “평택을 단일화, 국민 명령 따라야” 김용남 “가능성 희박”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk says, "In Pyeongtaek B, if a single opposition candidate emerges, we must follow the public's mandate." Kim Yong-nam says, "The possibility is slim." (조국 “평택을 단일화, 국민 명령 따라야” 김용남 “가능성 희박” )

Cho Kuk, a candidate for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party running in the by-election for Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B, held concurrently with the June 3 local elections, left the door open on the 20th regarding the potential for a unified opposition party candidate, stating, "If Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate, comes in first place, we must follow the public's mandate." In contrast, Kim Yong-nam, a candidate from the Democratic Party of Korea, said of the unification issue, "The possibility is very slim." <<> Candidate Cho made these remarks on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel that day, saying, "Shouldn't we prevent Candidate Yoo from winning?" Candidate Cho stated, "In the current situation, I see that the combined support for Yoo Ui-dong plus Hwang Kyo-ahn (Free and Innovation candidate) is decreasing," but added, "If a situation arises (where Candidate Hwang withdraws or a conservative candidate unification occurs) and Candidate Yoo takes first place, we must follow the public's mandate." <<> Regarding Candidate Kim Yong-nam, Candidate Cho said, "I see him having the ability and role (as an appointee), such as the head of the Financial Supervisory Service," but also noted, "Looking at matters like prosecutorial reform, (his stance differs greatly from the Democratic Party), so wouldn't serving as a lawmaker be problematic?" Candidate Cho argued, "If someone whose convictions differ from the president's on the spirit of the times, such as prosecutorial reform, enters the legislature, even the president cannot control them." <<> On the issue of merging parties, he said, "Once the local elections are over, I will fully launch a committee for solidarity and integration at my own level," adding, "I need to return to the National Assembly to push this forward more seriously and stably." <<> Meanwhile, Candidate Kim said on CBS Radio's 'Park Sung-tae's News Show' that day regarding a potential unification with Candidate Cho, "There has been no communication at all," and "As things stand, the possibility is very slim." <<> Candidate Kim stated, "For a unification to happen, a sense of solidarity must be formed, but what the Cho Kuk Innovation Party and Candidate Cho show is a stale election culture." He also said, "Legally, since candidate registration with the National Election Commission has already been completed, a unification without the candidate's consent is impossible," making it clear that he has no intention of pursuing unification. <<> In response to Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's remarks the previous day that "handing over a district to the People Power Party is something neither Democratic Party members nor Cho Kuk Innovation Party members would want," which had left the door open for potential unification, Candidate Kim said, "I still don't see any signs that the People Power Party can secure victory." Candidate Kim also stated, "I see the possibility of unification (between Yoo Ui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn) as low, and even if it happens, the synergistic effect won't be significant." <<> Regarding the possibility of unifying with Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, Candidate Kim said, "There haven't been (any discussions between working-level officials)," adding, "I deeply respect the values and policies of the Progressive Party, which focus on the value of labor and equality, so I think we are engaging in a good-faith competition." (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 경기 평택을 재선거에 출마한 조국 조국혁신당 후보는 20일 범여권 단일화에 대해 “유의동 국민의힘 후보가 1위를 하는 상황이 되면 국민 명령을 따라야 한다”면서 가능성을 열어놨다. 반면 김용남 더불어민주당 후보는 단일화 문제에 대해 “가능성이 매우 희박하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon's Camp Files Complaint Against MBC and Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for "Maliciously Distorted Reports on GTX Rebar Omission and Election Interference" (오세훈 측, “‘GTX 철근 누락’ 악의적 왜곡 보도·선거 개입” MBC·국토부 고발)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon's Camp Files Complaint Against MBC and Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for "Maliciously Distorted Reports on GTX Rebar Omission and Election Interference" (오세훈 측, “‘GTX 철근 누락’ 악의적 왜곡 보도·선거 개입” MBC·국토부 고발)

On the 20th, the camp of People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon filed a complaint with the police against MBC and officials from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act, in connection with suspicions raised over the "rebar omission" in the GTX (Great Train eXpress)-A Seoul Gangnam-gu Samseong Station section. (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보 측은 20일 GTX(수도권광역급행철도)-A 서울 강남구 삼성역 구간의 ‘철근 누락’과 관련한 의혹을 제기한 MBC와 국토교통부 관계자 등을 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 경찰에 고발했다.)

Oh Se-hoon's campaign announced in a press notice that morning, "Through our legal representatives, we have filed a complaint with the National Police Agency against MBC reporters and executives, as well as MOLIT officials, on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act." The campaign added, "We strongly urge the judicial authorities to conduct a thorough investigation and impose strict punishment for maliciously distorted and biased reporting and attempts to interfere in the election, which blind the eyes and ears of voters right before the election." (오세훈 후보 캠프는 이날 오전 언론 공지에서 “법률대리인을 통해 MBC 기자 및 간부들과 국토부 관계자를 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 경찰청에 고발했다”고 밝혔다. 오 후보 캠프는 “선거 직전 유권자의 눈과 귀를 가리는 악의적인 왜곡·편파 보도와 선거 개입 시도에 대해 사법당국의 철저한 수사와 엄중한 처벌을 강력히 촉구한다”고 했다.)

Oh's campaign stated that they have "submitted a complaint against seven individuals, including three MBC reporters and four executives, on charges of violating Article 96, Paragraph 2, Item 1 (false or distorted reporting), Article 252, Paragraph 1 (illegal use of broadcasting, newspapers, etc.), and Article 237, Paragraph 1, Item 2 (obstruction of election freedom) of the Election Act." According to Oh's camp, MBC distorted reports on Oh Se-hoon's Seoul city administration in reports aired on the 15th, 16th, and 18th, and gave biased coverage to the positions of Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jeong Won-o and Democratic Party lawmakers. (오 후보 캠프는 MBC 기자 3명과 간부 4명 등 7명에 대해 “선거법 제96조 제2항 제1호(허위·왜곡 보도), 제252조 제1항(방송·신문 등 부정이용죄), 제237조 제1항 제2호(선거의 자유방해죄) 위반 혐의로 고발장을 접수했다”고 밝혔다. MBC가 지난 15일, 16일, 18일 관련 보도를 하면서 오세훈 서울시정을 왜곡 보도했으며, 더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보와 민주당 의원 측 입장을 편파 보도했다는 게 오 후보 측 주장이다.)

Oh's campaign further stated, "We have also filed a complaint against the official responsible for MOLIT's decision to initiate an audit (regarding the rebar omission) on charges of violating Article 85, Paragraph 1 (prohibition of public officials' involvement in elections) of the Election Act." Earlier, on the 15th, MOLIT announced that construction errors had been confirmed in the Samseong Station section of the GTX-A line and that it had begun emergency on-site inspections and other measures. MOLIT stated that Seoul City had been aware of the construction error since November of last year but only reported it to MOLIT in April of this year, and based on this, it initiated an audit of Seoul City and others. (또 오 후보 캠프는 “국토부의 (철근 누락) 감사 착수 결정 담당자에 대해서도 선거법 제85조 제1항(공무원의 선거관여 등 금지 위반) 등의 혐의로 함께 고발했다”고 했다. 앞서 국토부는 지난 15일 GTX-A 노선 삼성역 구간에서 시공 오류가 확인돼 긴급 현장점검 등 조치에 착수했다고 발표했다. 국토부는 서울시가 공사 오류를 작년 11월 인지하고도 올해 4월 국토부에 보고했다면서, 이를 근거로 서울시 등에 대한 감수에 착수했다고 밝혔다.)

However, Seoul City refuted this, claiming that it had reported the supervision report containing the rebar omission at the Samseong Station section to the National Railroad Corporation under MOLIT three times: on November 13 and December 12 of last year, and on January 16 of this year. Additionally, Seoul City stated that after the contractor submitted the final construction plan for column reinforcement in March, it reviewed the field applicability and finalized the reinforcement plan, sharing it with the Railroad Corporation and MOLIT on the 24th and 29th of last month. Oh's camp argued that MOLIT was aware of these facts yet announced the decision to initiate an audit with the intention of influencing the Seoul mayoral election. (하지만 서울시는 국토부 산하 국가철도공단에 삼성역 구간 철근 누락 사항이 포함된 감리 보고서를 작년 11월 13일과 12월 12일, 올해 1월 16일 등 3차례 보고했다고 반박했다. 또 서울시는 지난 3월 시공사로부터 기둥 보강 최종 시공계획서가 제출되자 현장 적용성 등을 검토한 후 최종 보강방안을 확정해 지난달 24일과 29일 철도공단, 국토부에 공유했다고도 했다. 국토부가 이런 내용을 알고도 서울시장 선거에 영향을 미칠 목적으로 감사 착수 결정을 발표했다고 오 후보 측은 주장했다.)

item.title: Cho Seung-rae: "Kim Kwan-young's 'Party Member List Leak' Allegation Serious... Investigative Authorities Should Take Action" (조승래 “김관영 ‘당원명부 유출’ 의혹 심각...수사당국이 조치해야”)
item.description:
Cho Seung-rae: "Kim Kwan-young's 'Party Member List Leak' Allegation Serious... Investigative Authorities Should Take Action" (조승래 “김관영 ‘당원명부 유출’ 의혹 심각...수사당국이 조치해야”)

The Democratic Party of Korea stated on the 20th, regarding the allegation of a "rightful party member list leak" by the camp of Kim Kwan-young, who is running as an independent in the Jeonbuk governor election, that it is "very serious" and urged "whether it be the National Election Commission or investigative authorities, to take swift action." (더불어민주당은 20일 무소속으로 전북지사 선거에 출마한 김관영 후보 측의 ‘권리당원 명부 유출’ 의혹에 대해 “매우 심각하다”면서 “선거관리위원회든 수사당국이든 신속하게 조치를 취해 달라”고 했다.)

Jo Seung-rae, the secretary-general who serves as the general election headquarters chief for the Democratic Party in the June 3 local elections, held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the same day and said, "There was media coverage related to candidate Kim yesterday," making the remarks. (6·3 지방선거에서 민주당 총괄선대본부장을 맡은 조승래 사무총장은 이날 국회에서 기자간담회를 열고 “어제 김 후보와 관련된 언론 보도가 있었다”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

Secretary-General Jo stated, "There were reports and tips that the Jeonbuk party member list was illegally transferred to candidate Kim's camp. As far as I know, the whistleblower is the person who personally handed over the party member list." He added, "The whistleblower says they will submit related recordings and materials to the Election Commission today. The list was one intended for use in the presidential election and was supposed to be discarded afterward; it contains the names of 110,000 party members." He further noted, "If it was transferred, that alone is serious, and if the transfer route involved (candidate Kim's) secretary's office or public officials, it would constitute political interference by public officials." (조 사무총장은 “전북 당원 명부가 김 후보 측에 불법적으로 전달됐다는 제보와 보도가 있었다”면서 “제가 알기로 제보자가 직접 당원 명부를 전달한 사람”이라고 했다. 이어 “제보자가 오늘 선관위에 관련 녹취와 자료를 제출한다고 한다”면서 “명부는 대선에 활용하려고 했던 명부고, 이후 폐기하도록 돼 있는데 11만명의 당원 명단”이라고 밝혔다. 또 “전달이 됐다면 그 자체로 심각한 것이고, 전달 경로가 만약 (김 후보의) 비서실이나 공무원들이라면 공무원의 정치 개입이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Kim's election campaign committee stated in a position paper on the 19th, "The raised 'allegation of illegally obtaining the Democratic Party's list of 110,000 rightful party members' is entirely untrue and an obvious falsehood," adding, "Candidate Kim Kwan-young and the campaign have never received or used any illegal list." (김 후보 선거대책위원회는 지난 19일 입장문에서 “제기된 ‘민주당 권리당원 11만명 명부 불법 입수 의혹’은 전혀 사실이 아닌 명백한 허위 사실”이라며 “김관영 후보와 캠프는 어떠한 불법 명부도 전달받거나 활용한 사실이 전혀 없다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Secretary-General Jo criticized Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, regarding the omission of rebar in the construction of the GTX-A line Samsung Station, calling him "irresponsible and incompetent." Jo stated, "There is no greater case of the pot calling the kettle black than this. He seems to claim he didn't cover it up because he wasn't informed. Isn't Oh Se-hoon the top person responsible for Seoul's city administration? The fact that he didn't receive a report itself is absurd." (한편 조 사무총장은 GTX-A 노선 삼성역 공사 철근 누락 사건과 관련해 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보를 향해 “무책임하고 무능력하다”고 비판했다. 조 사무총장은 “적반하장도 이런 적반하장이 없다. 본인은 보고를 못 받았으니까 은폐한 것이 아니라고 주장하는 것 같다”면서 “서울시정 최고 책임자는 오세훈 아닌가. 보고 못 받은 것 자체가 황당하다”고 했다.)

Regarding Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, mentioning the re-proposal of a merger, Jo said, "The Democratic Party didn't deny it because we agreed to discuss it after the local elections," but added, "Connecting candidate Cho's election outcome with merger discussions seems like a forced logic. From the Democratic Party's perspective, one could think that if our candidate wins, the merger discussions would go much more smoothly." (조국 조국혁신당 대표의 합당 재추진 언급에 대해선 “합당은 민주당도 지선 이후에 논의하자고 했기 때문에 부인하지 않는다”면서도 “조 후보의 당락과 합당 논의를 연결하는 것은 억지 논리로 보인다. 민주당 입장에선 민주당 후보가 당선돼야 합당 논의가 훨씬 더 잘될 수 있다고 생각할 수 있다”고 했다.)

On the June 3 local elections, Secretary-General Jo said, "Politically, this election extends the presidential election, serving to sweep away incompetent remnants of insurrection even at the local government level. Secondly, it's about whether we can recover and revive regions that have been ruined by incompetent forces." Regarding the official campaign period starting from midnight on the 21st, he stated, "The starting point is Seoul. We will tour regions to inspect difficult livelihood situations, communicate with citizens, and create campaigns offering alternatives for regional development." (조 사무총장은 6·3 지방선거에 대해선 “이번 선거는 정치적으로는 대통령 선거의 연장선상에서 지방정부까지 무능한 내란 잔당을 소탕하는 의미가 있고, 두번째로는 무능 세력이 망쳐 놓은 지역을 회복하고 살려낼 것인가에 관한 선거”라고 했다. 21일 자정부터 시작되는 공식 선거운동 기간과 관련해선 “첫 출발점은 서울”이라면서 “지역을 다니면서 민생 어려운 현장을 살피고, 시민과 소통하면서 지역 발전의 대안을 만드는 캠페인을 하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

He also said, "In Seoul, Busan, Incheon, South Gyeongsang, Ulsan, North Gyeongsang, and Daegu, the current heads of local governments belong to the People Power Party. Our candidates are challenging them. We will conduct election campaigns more fiercely and actively with the mindset of challengers." (또 “서울, 부산, 인천, 경남, 울산, 경북, 대구 등은 현직 단체장이 국민의힘 소속이다. 우리 후보들이 도전하는 것”이라면서 “도전자의 마음으로 보다 더 치열하고 활발하게 선거 캠페인을 진행하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Now Targets 2019 Musinsa Ad: "How Can You Do This in Human Disguise" (李, 이번엔 2019년 무신사 광고 저격 “사람의 탈을 쓰고 이럴수가”)
item.description:
Lee Now Targets 2019 Musinsa Ad: "How Can You Do This in Human Disguise" (李, 이번엔 2019년 무신사 광고 저격 “사람의 탈을 쓰고 이럴수가”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 20th criticized domestic clothing shopping mall Musinsa for using the phrase "I slammed the desk and it went dry with a sigh" in a past advertisement, calling it "a mockery of the torture death case of martyr Park Jong-chul" and saying, "How can you do this while wearing a human mask?" (이재명 대통령은 20일 국내 의류 쇼핑몰인 무신사가 과거 광고에 ‘책상을 탁쳤더니 억하고 말라서’라는 문구를 사용한 것을 두고 “박종철 열사 고문치사 사건을 조롱하는 광고”라며 “사람의 탈을 쓰고 이럴수가 있나”라고 했다.)

President Lee shared on his X (formerly Twitter) that day a post from Musinsa’s SNS account promoting quick-drying socks with the phrase "Quick-drying: I slammed the desk and it went dry with a sigh," and made the statement. He claimed that this phrase evokes the police announcement from the 1987 Park Jong-chul torture death case, which stated, "When I slammed the desk, he said 'ugh' and died." (이 대통령은 이날 자신의 X(옛 트위터)에 무신사가 자사 SNS 계정에 건조가 잘 되는 양말을 홍보하며 ‘속건성 책상을 탁쳤더니 억하고 말라서’라는 문구를 쓴 것을 공유하며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 문구가 1987년 박종철 고문치사 사건 당시 “책상을 탁 치니 억 하고 죽었다”고 한 경찰 발표 내용을 연상시킨다는 것이다.)

President Lee said, "This is an advertisement that insults and mocks the torture death case of martyr Park Jong-chul and the June Democratic Uprising that it sparked," adding, "I received a tip about this, but I need to check if it's true." He continued, "I hope it's not true, but if it is, it's a very serious problem," and asked, "Money may be the devil, but how can you do this while wearing a human mask?" (이 대통령은 “박종철 열사 고문치사 사건, 그로 시발된 6월 민주항쟁을 모욕하고 조롱하는 광고”라며 “제보받은 것인데 진짜인지 확인해 봐야겠다”고 했다. 이어 “사실이 아니길 바라지만, 사실이라면 참으로 심각한 문제”라며 “돈이 마귀라지만 사람의 탈을 쓰고 이럴수가 있나”라고 했다.)

However, this advertisement was posted in 2019, and at that time, Musinsa removed the ad and issued an apology after controversy arose. When it became known that this was an old ad, the presidential office stated, "This reflects President Lee’s consistent philosophy and will to thoroughly root out insults, historical distortions, and trivialization of the democratization movement and its victims." <<> On the 18th, President Lee had also strongly criticized Starbucks Korea for using phrases like "Slam on the desk!" and "5·18 Tank Day" in a promotion for a "Tank Tumbler Set" merchandise, saying, "I am outraged by the inhumane, bottom-feeding behavior of these low-life merchants who deny democratic values." (다만 이 광고는 2019년 게재된 것으로, 당시 무신사는 논란이 일자 해당 광고를 삭제하고 사과문을 올린 바 있다. 과거 광고였던 것이 알려지자 청와대는 “민주화운동 및 희생자에 대한 모독과 역사 왜곡, 희화화가 지속적으로 발생하는 것에 대해 발본색원하려는 (이 대통령의) 평소 철학과 의지가 반영된 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: PM Kim: "Election Law Violations Sharply Increasing… Will Enforce Maximum Penalties for Election Crimes" (金총리 “선거법 위반 크게 늘어… 선거 범죄 최고 형량으로 엄단할 것”)
item.description:
PM Kim: "Election Law Violations Sharply Increasing… Will Enforce Maximum Penalties for Election Crimes" (金총리 “선거법 위반 크게 늘어… 선거 범죄 최고 형량으로 엄단할 것”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 20th that, ahead of the June 3 local elections, cases of election law violations have significantly increased, and announced that the government will take strict, zero-tolerance measures against election crimes. (김민석 국무총리가 20일 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 선거법 위반 사례가 크게 늘고 있다며 선거 범죄에 무관용 원칙으로 엄정하게 조치하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Prime Minister Kim presided over the second ministerial meeting on fair elections at the Government Complex in Seoul on the morning of that day. The meeting was attended by ministers, vice ministers, and senior officials from relevant agencies, including the Ministry of Science and ICT, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Korea Communications Commission, the Ministry of Personnel Management, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, and the National Police Agency. (김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 제2차 공명 선거 관계 장관 회의를 주재했다. 회의에는 과학기술정보통신·교육·법무·국방·행정안전·문화체육관광·보건복지부와 방송미디어통신위원회·인사혁신처·대검찰청·경찰청 등 관계 기관 장·차관과 고위 관료들이 참석했다.)

At the meeting, Prime Minister Kim said, "The June 3 nationwide simultaneous local elections are two weeks away, and official election campaigns begin tomorrow (the 21st), with over 4,200 candidates competing nationwide. As campaigns intensify, there are concerns that competition may overheat and illegal activities may occur." (이 자리에서 김 총리는 “6·3 전국동시지방선거가 2주 앞으로 다가왔고 내일(21일)부터 본격적으로 선거운동이 시작된다”며 “전국에서 4200명이 넘는 후보자가 경쟁하는 만큼, 선거운동이 본격화되면 경쟁이 과열되고 불법 행위가 발생할 우려가 있다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim noted, "In fact, compared to the same period during the 2022 local elections, cases of election law violations are increasing sharply. The government will take a serious stance and do its utmost to establish order in the elections." (김 총리는 “실제로 2022년 지방선거 대비 같은 기간의 선거법 위반 사례가 큰 폭으로 증가하고 있다”며 “정부는 엄중한 자세로 선거 질서 확립에 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim stated, "First, for the three major election crimes—black propaganda such as spreading fake news, offering money or favors to voters, and intervention by public officials in elections—we will apply a zero-tolerance principle and take swift, strict measures." (김 총리는 “우선, 가짜 뉴스 유포 등 흑색선전, 유권자에 대한 금품·향응 수수, 공직자 선거 개입 등 3대 선거 범죄에 대해서는 무관용 원칙으로 신속하고 엄정하게 조치하겠다”고 했다.)

He added, "In particular, election crimes such as deepfakes created by abusing AI obscure the public's rational judgment and have highly negative effects. We will promptly remove them and thoroughly track down the original creators as well as those who distribute them, ensuring they are completely eradicated." (이어 “특히 AI(인공지능)를 악용한 딥페이크 등 선거 범죄는 국민의 합리적 판단을 흐리게 하고 부정적 효과도 매우 크다”며 “신속하게 삭제 조치하고 최초 제작자부터 유포자까지 철저하게 추적해 반드시 뿌리 뽑도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

"Relevant agencies, including the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the prosecution, and the police, should cooperate organically to respond quickly, and I ask that criminals be punished with the maximum sentences permitted by law," he said. (그러면서 “법무부, 행안부, 검·경 등 관계 기관은 유기적으로 협력해 신속히 대응하고, 범죄자에게는 법이 허용하는 최대의 형량으로 엄단해 주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim also instructed, "The government will support citizens so they can exercise their precious votes without inconvenience. The Ministry of the Interior and Safety should thoroughly inspect the readiness of each early voting station and main polling station in advance." He added, "Relevant ministries such as the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the Ministry of National Defense should diligently provide necessary guidance and publicity to students, elderly and disabled individuals with mobility challenges, and young voters fulfilling their national defense duties, and ensure that absentee polling stations are smoothly provided." (김 총리는 또 “정부는 국민이 소중한 한 표를 행사하는 데 불편함이 없도록 지원하겠다”며 “행안부는 사전 투표소와 본투표소의 준비 상황을 사전에 하나하나 점검해 달라”고 주문했다. “교육부, 복지부, 국방부 등 관계 부처도 학생, 거동이 불편한 노인·장애인, 국방의 의무를 다하고 있는 청년 유권자 등에게 필요한 안내와 홍보를 충실히 하고, 거소 투표소가 원활하게 제공될 수 있도록 해달라”고 했다.)

item.title: ACRC: "Revoking License for Refusing Breathalyzer Test Is Not Excessive" (권익위 “‘음주 측정 불응하면 반드시 면허 취소’ 과도하지 않아”)
item.description:
ACRC: "Revoking License for Refusing Breathalyzer Test Is Not Excessive" (권익위 “‘음주 측정 불응하면 반드시 면허 취소’ 과도하지 않아”)

An administrative ruling has determined that it is valid to revoke the driver's license of a motorist who refused a police officer's request for a breathalyzer test. (경찰의 음주 측정 요구에 불응한 운전자의 운전면허를 취소한 것은 타당하다는 행정심판 결정이 나왔다.)

The Central Administrative Appeals Commission under the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission announced on the 20th that it rejected an administrative appeal filed by individual A, whose driver’s license was revoked for failing to comply with a police officer's request for a breathalyzer test. (국민권익위원회 중앙행정심판위원회는 경찰공무원의 음주 측정 요구에 응하지 않아 운전면허가 취소된 A씨가 낸 행정심판 청구를 받아들이지 않았다고 20일 밝혔다.)

According to the commission, A was involved in a traffic accident while riding a motorcycle, colliding with a median barrier and falling over. During the investigation, police noticed that A was stuttering and staggering as he walked, leading them to suspect drunk driving. When police requested a breathalyzer test, A only pretended to blow into the device. As a result, police revoked A’s Class 2 ordinary and Class 2 small vehicle licenses for refusing the test. A argued that he had no intention to refuse the test, had no prior record of drunk driving, needed his license to make a living, and claimed that revoking his license was an excessive penalty. (중앙행심위에 따르면, A씨는 오토바이를 운전하다가 중앙분리대와 부딪혀 넘어지는 교통사고를 냈다. 경찰은 사고를 조사하는 과정에서 A씨가 말을 더듬거리고 비틀거리며 걷는다는 것을 알고 음주 운전을 의심했다. 경찰이 음주 측정을 요구했으나 A씨는 음주 측정기에 숨을 부는 시늉만 했다. 그러자 경찰은 음주 측정 불응을 이유로 A씨의 2종 보통, 2종 소형 운전면허를 취소했다. A씨는 음주 측정에 불응하려는 의도가 없었고, 음주 운전 경력이 없는 초범이며, 생계를 위해 운전면허가 필요하다며, 운전면허를 취소하는 것은 지나친 제재라고 주장했다.)

The commission ruled, "There were substantial grounds to believe A had been driving under the influence, and he refused the test despite being asked. The Road Traffic Act mandates the revocation of all licenses for any driver who refuses a breathalyzer test," adding that "the revocation of the license was neither illegal nor unjust." (중앙행심위는 “A씨가 음주 운전을 했다고 볼 만한 상당한 이유가 있어 음주 측정을 요구받았는데도 불응했고, 도로교통법은 음주 측정에 불응한 운전자의 모든 운전면허를 반드시 취소하도록 정하고 있다”며 “운전면허 취소 처분이 위법·부당하지 않다”고 판단했다.)

It further noted, "If A had complied with the test, and his blood alcohol concentration was below 0.03%, he would not have been subject to any administrative license action; if it had been between 0.03% and 0.08%, he might have received a 100-day license suspension." (또 “A씨가 음주 측정에 응했다면 혈중 알코올 농도가 0.03% 미만이었다면 운전면허 행정 처분 대상이 되지 않거나, 0.03~0.08%였다면 운전면허 정지 처분 100일을 받을 수도 있었다”고 지적했다.)

Cho So-young, chair of the Central Administrative Appeals Commission, stated, "This ruling confirms that refusing a breathalyzer test results in the revocation of all driver's licenses. To reduce legal disadvantages, drivers must actively cooperate with legitimate police breathalyzer procedures and comply with relevant laws." (조소영 중앙행심위원장은 “음주 측정에 응하지 않으면 모든 운전면허가 취소된다는 것을 확인한 결정”이라며 “운전자가 법적 불이익을 줄이기 위해서는 경찰의 정당한 음주 측정 절차에 적극 협조하는 등 관련 법규를 준수해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: AI Adoption and Small-Case Clearance in First Half of Year… Tax Tribunal Announces Reform Plan (AI 도입, 소액 사건 상반기 모두 처리… 조세심판원 개혁안 발표)
item.description:
AI Adoption and Small-Case Clearance in First Half of Year… Tax Tribunal Announces Reform Plan (AI 도입, 소액 사건 상반기 모두 처리… 조세심판원 개혁안 발표)

The processing speed of the Tax Tribunal, where citizens who disagree with government tax assessments can seek adjudication, will accelerate. The Tax Tribunal plans to resolve most small-amount cases that have accumulated without being handled for long periods within the first half of this year, and to prevent backlogs in case processing by increasing the number of adjudicators and establishing an AI-based case processing system. (정부의 과세 처분에 불복한 국민이 해당 처분에 대해 심판을 받을 수 있는 조세심판원의 사건 처리 속도가 빨라진다. 조세심판원은 장기간 처리하지 않고 쌓아둔 소액 사건을 상반기 중으로 대부분 처리하고, 앞으로도 사건 처리가 밀리지 않도록 심판관 수를 늘리고 AI(인공지능)를 기반으로 한 사건 처리 체계를 구축하기로 했다.)

The Tax Tribunal under the Office for Government Policy Coordination announced the "Tax Tribunal Reform Plan" centered on these measures on the 20th. In February, President Lee Jae-myung singled out the Tax Tribunal during a regular meeting with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, calling for reforms, and it is known that the Prime Minister's Office and the Tax Tribunal subsequently devised the reform plan. (국무조정실 조세심판원은 20일 이 같은 내용을 골자로 하는 ‘조세심판원 개혁 방안’을 발표했다. 지난 2월 이재명 대통령은 김민석 국무총리와의 주례 회동에서 조세심판원을 지목해 개혁을 주문했고, 이에 총리실과 조세심판원이 개혁안을 마련한 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to the Tax Tribunal, the average processing time for tax adjudication claims has been steadily increasing, from 172 days in 2023 to 185 days in 2024 and 225 days last year. Accordingly, recognizing that small-amount cases are particularly tied to people's livelihoods, the Tax Tribunal has decided to separately manage small-amount cases that have exceeded 180 days since filing without a conclusion. Long-pending cases will be managed under the responsibility of each department head, and the handling of such cases will be reflected in performance evaluations. More than half of the long-pending cases that have not been resolved for over a year will be processed within the first half, and all remaining small-amount cases exceeding 180 days will be cleared within the same period. (조세심판원에 따르면, 조세 심판 청구 사건의 평균 처리 일수는 2023년 172일에서 2024년 185일, 지난해 225일로 지속적으로 늘고 있다. 이에 따라 조세심판원은 특히 소액 사건이 민생과 직결돼 있다고 보고, 접수된 지 180일이 넘도록 결론을 내지 않은 소액 사건을 별도로 관리하기로 했다. 장기 미결 사건은 각 과장이 책임지고 관리하고, 장기 미결 사건 처리를 성과 평가에도 반영하기로 했다. 1년이 넘게 결론을 내지 못한 장기 미결 사건은 상반기 안에 절반 이상 처리하고, 나머지 사건 가운데 180일을 넘긴 소액 사건도 상반기 안에 모두 처리하기로 했다.)

AI will be introduced by September to reduce the time spent drafting case investigation reports. When a staff member uploads the claimant's statement of grounds and the tax authority's response, the AI will analyze the issues and produce a draft case investigation report. A system will also be introduced by next year, where a citizen can input reasons for filing an adjudication claim into a chat window, and the AI will automatically draft the statement of grounds and search for and provide relevant precedent rulings. Additionally, cases with similar issues will be merged and assigned to a single case handler to enhance efficiency and consistency in processing. The number of non-standing adjudicators, currently 36, will be gradually increased. (오는 9월까지 AI를 도입해, 사건 조사서 작성에 들어가는 시간을 줄이기로 했다. 국민이 낸 청구 이유서와 조세 관청의 답변서를 담당자가 올리면, AI가 쟁점을 분석해 사건 조사서 초안을 작성해 주게 하는 것이다. 국민이 심판 청구를 하는 이유를 대화창에 입력하면, AI가 청구 이유서를 자동으로 작성해 주고 관련 있는 결정례를 검색해 알려주는 시스템도 이듬해까지 도입하기로 했다. 또 쟁점이 비슷한 사건은 한 담당자에게 병합해 배정해 사건 처리의 효율성과 일관성을 높이기로 했다. 현재 36명인 비상임 심판관도 단계적으로 늘리기로 했다.)

Measures to enhance transparency in case processing will also be implemented. Case investigation reports will be made available for prior review by case parties, such as claimants, to ensure their right to defense. Furthermore, every 45 days after case acceptance, automatic notifications will be sent on the case status and reasons for delays, and if necessary, claimants will be able to request recusal, with the list of adjudicators, their affiliations, and areas of expertise disclosed on the Tax Tribunal's website. Joint meetings of adjudicators handling major cases will be open to the public, and each adjudicator will be required to submit an opinion document summarizing the basis for their judgment. (사건 처리의 투명성을 높이기 위한 조치도 시행된다. 사건 조사서는 청구인 등 사건 당사자가 사전에 열람할 수 있게 해 방어권을 보장하기로 했다. 또 사건 접수 후 45일마다 사건 진행 현황과 지연 사유 등을 자동으로 통보해주고, 청구인이 필요한 경우 기피 신청을 할 수 있도록 조세심판관의 명단과 소속, 전문 분야를 조세심판원 홈페이지에 공개하기로 했다. 주요 사건을 다루는 조세심판관 합동 회의는 공개하고, 이때 각 심판관은 자신의 판단 근거를 문서 형태로 정리한 의견서를 내게 하기로 했다.)

Measures to enhance the integrity of Tax Tribunal staff have also been prepared. A dedicated audit team for the Tax Tribunal will be established within the Office for Government Policy Coordination, and an integrity and ethics team will be created within the Tax Tribunal itself. Additionally, the asset declaration requirement, previously applied only to grade 4 and above public officials, will be expanded to grade 7 and above. As a result, grade 5 to 7 officials at the Tax Tribunal will also need to undergo employment review if they seek to join related private companies after retirement. (조세심판원 직원들의 청렴도를 높이기 위한 조치도 준비됐다. 국조실에는 조세심판원 전담 감사팀을 신설하고, 조세심판원 자체에도 청렴윤리팀을 두기로 했다. 또 지금까지 4급 이상 공무원에게만 적용되던 재산 신고 의무를 7급 이상으로 확대하기로 했다. 이에 따라 조세심판원 5~7급 공무원도 퇴직 후 관련 민간 기업에 취업하려면 취업 심사를 받아야 한다.)

Tax Tribunal President Lee Sang-gil stated, "Marking the 50th anniversary of the tribunal's establishment last year, we have prepared a reform plan to prepare for the next half-century," adding, "We will implement it without a hitch so that changes perceptible to the public are practically realized at the adjudication site." (조세심판원 이상길 원장은 “지난해 개청 50주년을 계기로 앞으로 새로운 반세기를 준비하기 위해 개혁 방안을 마련했다”며 “국민이 체감할 수 있는 변화가 심판 현장에서 실질적으로 구현되도록 차질 없이 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Special Travel Expense Benefits for Officials in South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City… Continue to Receive ‘Out-of-Area Travel’ Allowance as Before (전남광주 통합 특별시 공무원에 출장비 특례… 지금처럼 ‘관외 출장’ 돈 받는다)
item.description:
Special Travel Expense Benefits for Officials in South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City… Continue to Receive ‘Out-of-Area Travel’ Allowance as Before (전남광주 통합 특별시 공무원에 출장비 특례… 지금처럼 ‘관외 출장’ 돈 받는다)

Public officials working in the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City, launching on July 1, will receive special treatment in travel expenses. (7월 1일 출범하는 전남광주통합특별시에서 일하는 공무원들이 출장비에서 특례를 받게 됐다.)

The Ministry of Personnel Management announced on the 20th that it has pre-announced legislation for an amendment to the ‘Public Officials Travel Expense Regulations’ containing such content. (인사혁신처는 20일 이 같은 내용을 담은 ‘공무원 여비 규정’ 개정안을 입법 예고했다고 밝혔다.)

According to the Ministry, officials working in Gwangju Metropolitan City or South Jeolla Province currently receive 25,000 won per day for daily allowances, 25,000 won for meals, actual expenses for transportation, and up to 70,000 won (South Jeolla) or 80,000 won (Gwangju) for actual accommodation costs when traveling from Gwangju to South Jeolla or from South Jeolla to Gwangju. However, if the two local governments are integrated into one, such travel would be treated as ‘travel within the workplace,’ allowing only a total of 10,000 won per day (if the travel time is less than 4 hours) or 20,000 won (if 4 hours or more). (인사처에 따르면, 광주광역시나 전라남도에서 일하는 공무원들은 현재는 광주에서 전남으로, 전남에서 광주로 출장을 갈 때 하루에 일비로 2만5000원, 식비로 2만5000원, 운임으로 실비, 숙박비로 최대 7만원(전남) 또는 8만원(광주)의 실비를 받는다. 하지만 두 지방자치단체가 하나로 통합되면 ‘근무지 내 출장’으로 취급돼, 하루에 총 1만원(출장 시간이 4시간 미만인 경우) 또는 2만원(4시간 이상인 경우)만 받을 수 있게 된다.)

In response, the Ministry decided to amend the travel expense regulations to pay travel expenses based on the administrative districts before integration in the case of an integrated special city under the Local Autonomy Act. The same standard will apply not only to South Jeolla-Gwangju but also to other regions when an integrated special city is launched. (그러자 인사처는 공무원 여비 규정을 개정해, 지방자치법상 통합특별시인 경우에는 통합 이전의 관할 구역을 기준으로 출장비를 지급하기로 했다. 전남광주뿐 아니라 다른 지역에서도 통합특별시가 출범하면 동일한 기준이 적용된다.)

The Ministry also stated that it will include a provision in the new travel expense regulations requiring public officials to make efforts to donate any air miles accumulated through official travel. (인사처는 또 공무원의 출장으로 공무원 개인에게 항공 마일리지가 적립된 경우, 해당 공무원은 그 마일리지를 기부하도록 노력해야 한다는 조항도 새로운 공무원 여비 규정에 포함시키겠다고 밝혔다.)

Minister of Personnel Management, Dong-seok Choi, said, “We have ensured that expenses incurred in the course of official duties are properly compensated even after the launch of the integrated special city,” adding, “We expect travel expenses to be paid appropriately.” He also said, “We hope that donations using public officials’ air miles will become more widespread.” (최동석 인사처장은 “통합특별시 출범 이후에도 공무 수행 과정에서 발생되는 비용이 적절히 보전되도록 했다”며 “여비가 적절히 지급되기를 기대한다”고 말했다. “공무원의 항공 마일리지를 활용한 기부가 확산되기를 기대한다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae Expresses "Deep Regret" over Breakdown of Samsung Electronics Labor-Management Talks (靑, 삼성전자 노사 협상 결렬에 “매우 유감”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae Expresses "Deep Regret" over Breakdown of Samsung Electronics Labor-Management Talks (靑, 삼성전자 노사 협상 결렬에 “매우 유감”)

Cheong Wa Dae on the 20th expressed "deep regret" over the collapse of the second post-mediation session between Samsung Electronics' labor and management. (청와대는 20일 삼성전자 노사의 2차 사후 조정 결렬에 “매우 유감”이라고 했다.)

Senior Cheong Wa Dae Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung said in a statement, "We deeply regret that the post-mediation session at the Central Labor Relations Commission has broken down," adding, "Even before the final deadline, we urge both sides to make every effort to reach a labor-management agreement, considering the potential impact on the Korean economy." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 공지를 통해 “중앙노동위원회 사후 조정이 결렬된 것에 대해 매우 유감”이라며 “최종 시한 전이라도 한국 경제에 미칠 우려를 고려해 마지막까지 노사 합의를 위해 최선을 다해주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Earlier that day, Samsung Electronics' labor and management held discussions in the morning but failed to reach an agreement. The Central Labor Relations Commission officially announced the breakdown of the second post-mediation session. Following the breakdown, the union declared it would launch a general strike on the 21st. (앞서 삼성전자 노사는 이날 오전 협의에 나섰지만 합의에는 이르지 못했다. 중앙노동위원회는 삼성전자 노사의 2차 사후 조정이 결렬됐다고 공식 발표했다. 노조는 결렬에 따라 21일 총파업 돌입을 선언했다.)

item.title: Government Raises Terror Alert to 'Caution' from May 21… First Time Ahead of Elections (정부, 21일부터 테러 경보 ‘주의’로 격상… 선거 앞두고 처음)
item.description:
Government Raises Terror Alert to 'Caution' from May 21… First Time Ahead of Elections (정부, 21일부터 테러 경보 ‘주의’로 격상… 선거 앞두고 처음)

The government announced on the 20th that it will raise the nationwide terror alert level ahead of the June 3 local elections. This marks the first time the terror alert level has been elevated during an election period. (정부가 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 전국의 테러 경보를 상향 조정한다고 20일 밝혔다. 선거 기간을 맞아 테러 경보 수준을 올리는 것은 처음이다.)

The Counter-Terrorism Center under the Office for Government Policy Coordination stated on the afternoon of the same day, "To strengthen counter-terrorism safety activities during the election period, we have decided, through consultations among relevant agencies, to raise the terror alert level starting from the 21st." (국무조정실 대테러센터는 이날 오후 “선거 기간 중 대테러 안전 활동을 강화하기 위해, 관계 기관 간 협의를 거쳐 21일부터 테러 경보 단계를 상향 조정하기로 결정했다”고 밝혔다.)

Terror alerts are divided into four stages—'Blue,' 'Yellow,' 'Orange,' and 'Red'—based on the level of threat, with the current level being the lowest, 'Blue.' The Counter-Terrorism Center decided to raise the alert to 'Yellow' from midnight on the 21st, when the official election campaign begins, until noon on June 4, the day after the election. (테러 경보는 테러 위협 정도에 따라 ‘관심’ ‘주의’ ‘경계’ ‘심각’의 4단계로 구분되고, 현재는 가장 낮은 ‘관심’ 단계다. 대테러센터는 공식 선거운동이 시작되는 21일 0시부터 선거일 다음 날인 6월 4일 12시까지 테러 경보를 ‘주의’로 한 단계 올리기로 했다.)

Regarding the new terror alert level, the Counter-Terrorism Center explained, "Response measures corresponding to the alert level will be implemented promptly. Relevant agencies will strengthen surveillance and patrols at major event venues and public facilities, and enhance joint response systems among related organizations to ensure immediate action when incidents occur." (새로운 테러 경보 단계와 관련해 대테러센터는 “경보 단계별 대응 조치를 신속히 시행하게 된다”며 “관계 기관은 주요 행사장과 다중 이용 시설에 대한 경계와 순찰을 강화하고, 상황 발생 시 즉각 대응할 수 있도록 유관 기관 간 합동 대응 체계를 강화할 방침”이라고 설명했다.)

A Counter-Terrorism Center official stated, "While no specific terror threat intelligence has been received, following the 2024 attack on President Lee Jae-myung, it has been pointed out that increased vigilance is necessary during election periods, leading to the decision to raise the alert level." (대테러센터 관계자는 “구체적인 테러 위협 첩보가 들어온 것은 아니지만, 2024년 이재명 대통령 피습 사건 이후로 선거 기간에는 주의를 기울일 필요가 있다는 지적에 따라 경보 단계를 올리게 됐다”고 밝혔다.)

Earlier in January, the government classified the attack on President Lee, then leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who was stabbed in the neck with a knife on January 2, 2024, at the site of the Gadeokdo New Airport in Busan, as an act of terrorism under the Anti-Terrorism Act during a meeting of the National Counter-Terrorism Committee chaired by Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. (앞서 지난 1월 정부는 2024년 1월 2일 당시 더불어민주당 대표였던 이 대통령이 부산 가덕도 신공항 부지에서 흉기로 목을 공격당한 사건을 김민석 국무총리 주재 국가테러대책위원회 회의에서 테러방지법상 테러로 지정한 바 있다.)

The Counter-Terrorism Center stated, "With this alert issuance, the government plans to have all relevant agencies cooperate as one to maintain a thorough state of preparedness, responding swiftly and seamlessly to any situation during the election period to ensure the successful conduct of the local elections." (대테러센터는 “정부는 이번 경보 발령을 계기로 모든 관계 기관이 하나로 협력해 철저한 대비 태세를 유지함으로써, 선거 기간 중 어떤 상황에도 신속하고 빈틈없이 대응해 지방선거가 성공적으로 진행될 수 있도록 최선을 다할 계획”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Coupang and the Online Platform Act... Could They Become Obstacles to the South Korea-U.S. 'Nuclear Submarine' Push? (쿠팡·온플법 문제...한미 ‘원잠’ 추진 걸림돌 되나)
item.description:
Coupang and the Online Platform Act... Could They Become Obstacles to the South Korea-U.S. 'Nuclear Submarine' Push? (쿠팡·온플법 문제...한미 ‘원잠’ 추진 걸림돌 되나 )

South Korea and the United States have decided to launch a working group to implement the joint fact sheet agreed upon at last year's summit between the two countries. Discussions on the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (SSNs) and the expansion of nuclear enrichment and reprocessing authority between South Korea and the U.S., which have been stalled for the past six months, may now gain full momentum. However, challenges are anticipated as the U.S. emphasizes the fulfillment of investment promises to the U.S. and the need for fair treatment of American companies. <<> According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 20th, the first meeting to implement the JFS in the security sector between the two countries will be held in South Korea next month. U.S. State Department Under Secretary for Political Affairs, Allison Hooker, is expected to visit South Korea leading a joint U.S. delegation in a few weeks. This follows a meeting on the 19th (local time) between South Korea's First Vice Foreign Minister, Park Yoon-joo, who is visiting the U.S., and Under Secretary Hooker, where they exchanged views on overall South Korea-U.S. relations, including JFS implementation, the Korean Peninsula issues, and regional and global situations. <<> The U.S. State Department stated in a press release that day, "We look forward to continued progress in the trade and industrial partnership between the two countries," while also emphasizing "the need to ensure fair treatment for U.S. companies and the swift removal of market access barriers." This is interpreted as highlighting the implementation of South Korea's investment promises to the U.S. and pointing to issues such as unfair treatment of U.S. companies like Coupang and South Korea's 'Online Platform Act,' which is cited as a non-tariff barrier. This means that issues such as investment in the U.S. and Coupang could act as stumbling blocks in security sector negotiations like nuclear submarines and enrichment/reprocessing. Our Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not include such content in its materials, prompting criticism that a gap in perception between the two countries has been revealed. <<> Meanwhile, according to data submitted by the Ministry of National Defense to the office of Representative Kang Dae-shik of the National Defense Committee on the 20th, the Navy recently submitted a request for a nuclear submarine to the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS). This request is the first official procedure in the acquisition process, where the military asks higher authorities for necessary items such as operational performance, operational concepts, required numbers, and deployment timelines when pursuing the introduction of a new weapons system or capability enhancement. The JCS is currently reviewing the Navy's request and is reportedly planning to hold a Joint Chiefs of Staff meeting this month to finalize the decision on nuclear submarine requirements. <<> Representative Kang Dae-shik pointed out, "While there have been important discussions recently, such as the phone call between the South Korean and U.S. leaders and the meeting of defense ministers, there has been no explanation at all regarding the plan to secure nuclear fuel. The priority should be to clearly explain the prerequisite condition of securing nuclear fuel to the public first." <<> The government is pushing to announce the 'Basic Plan for the Development of South Korea's Nuclear-Powered Submarine,' which will include South Korea's principles on securing nuclear submarines, construction plans, and its stance on nuclear non-proliferation, by the end of this month. The announcement of the basic plan is expected to present a specific timeline and a blueprint for South Korea's nuclear submarine program. (한·미 양국이 지난해 정상회담을 통해 합의된 한미 정상회담 공동 설명자료(조인트팩트시트) 이행을 위한 실무 워킹그룹을 출범하기로 했다. 지난 6개월간 답보 상태에 머물렀던 한·미 간 원자력추진잠수함(원잠) 도입 및 원자력 농축·재처리 권한 확대 논의가 본격 궤도에 오를 수 있다. 하지만 미국은 대미투자 약속 이행과 미국 기업에 대한 공정한 대우 필요성을 강조하고 있어 어려움도 예상된다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on President Lee’s Review of Netanyahu Arrest Warrant: “Will You Also Arrest Kim Jong-un and Putin? Please Show Restraint” (‘네타냐후 체포영장 검토’ 李대통령에... 이준석 “김정은·푸틴도 체포할거냐, 제발 자중하라”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok on President Lee’s Review of Netanyahu Arrest Warrant: “Will You Also Arrest Kim Jong-un and Putin? Please Show Restraint” (‘네타냐후 체포영장 검토’ 李대통령에... 이준석 “김정은·푸틴도 체포할거냐, 제발 자중하라”)

Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok on the 20th responded to President Lee Jae-myung’s order for the presidential office to review the execution of an arrest warrant for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu if he enters South Korea, saying, “Please exercise caution and self-restraint.” (개혁신당 이준석 대표는 20일 이재명 대통령이 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리가 한국으로 들어올 경우 체포영장을 집행하는 방안을 청와대에 검토해보라고 한 것과 관련해 “제발 자중자애하라”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that afternoon, Lee Jun-seok stated, “Please become the President of the Republic of Korea who understands the weight of life and death in every word, not the Seongnam Mayor Lee Jae-myung who used to blurt out whatever came to mind on Twitter,” and added this remark. <<> Lee brought up incidents such as the North Korean shooting death of a South Korean civil servant in the West Sea and the sinking of the Cheonan, arguing, “If we follow President Lee’s standards, the first arrest warrant that should be issued would be for North Korea’s Kim Jong-un.” Regarding the attack on the ‘Namuho,’ a multipurpose cargo ship owned by South Korea’s largest shipping company HMM, in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, Lee said, “President Lee Jae-myung, who do you think attacked the Namuho? Do you have the courage to bring up an arrest warrant for that entity too? You remain silent on incidents where our citizens are harmed, yet you speak of arresting a foreign leader.” The government has confirmed the attack on the Namuho but has not yet identified the culprit. <<> He continued, “If you’re going to bring up warrants for foreign leaders, you should also mention Russian President Vladimir Putin. The ICC (International Criminal Court) already issued a warrant for Putin in 2023 on charges of unlawfully deporting Ukrainian children. If we follow President Lee’s standards, the South Korean government should first clarify its willingness to cooperate with that warrant. Would you arrest Putin if he visits South Korea?” <<> Lee noted, “Netanyahu is at least undergoing trial for his criminal charges, and the authority of Israel’s Supreme Court remains unchallenged. In a situation where you are dismantling the judicial system and demonizing the Chief Justice to avoid your own trial, calling for the arrest of a foreign leader who is silently facing his own trial could seem like turning the tables.” He then told President Lee, “The qualification to discuss arrest warrants for foreign leaders comes from someone who has at least the minimal conscience to appear in their own court.” <<> Earlier that day, during a cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office, President Lee mentioned the arrest warrant issued by the ICC for Prime Minister Netanyahu, saying, “Hasn’t he been recognized as a war criminal by the ICC, and an arrest warrant issued?” This remark came while criticizing the Israeli navy’s seizure of an aid flotilla carrying South Korean activists approaching Gaza. <<> President Lee then said, “Until now, we may have considered diplomatic relations, but haven’t most European countries declared they would arrest Netanyahu if he enters their territory? Let’s also make a judgment on this.” In response, Presidential Security Chief Wi Sung-lac replied, “I will review it.” (이준석 대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에서 “트위터에 떠오르는 대로 아무 말이나 쏟아내시던 성남시장 이재명이 아니라 말 한마디에 나라가 죽고 사는 무게를 아시는 대한민국 대통령이 되어달라”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Lee: "Demands for Pre-Tax Operating Profit Sharing, Some Unions Crossed the Line" ([속보] 李 “세전 영업이익 배분 요구, 일부 노조가 선 넘었다”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Lee: "Demands for Pre-Tax Operating Profit Sharing, Some Unions Crossed the Line" ([속보] 李 “세전 영업이익 배분 요구, 일부 노조가 선 넘었다”)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office on the 20th, "Sharing operating profits before taxes are deducted is something even investors cannot do," adding, "Some unions have crossed the appropriate line." This is interpreted as a remark aimed at the Samsung Electronics union, which has recently been demanding institutional distribution of pre-tax operating profits, citing strong performance. (이재명 대통령은 20일 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 “세금 떼기 전 영업이익을 나눠 갖는 건 투자자도 못하는 일”이라며 “일부 노조가 적정한 선을 넘었다”고 했다. 이는 최근 실적 호조를 이유로 세전 영업이익의 제도적 분배를 요구하고 있는 삼성전자 노조를 겨냥한 발언으로 풀이된다.)

In his opening remarks, the President mentioned a social "moral boundary (a line that should not be crossed)." He opened by saying, "For a society to function properly, we must adhere to an appropriate line," and "Although the law may not explicitly stipulate it, there is a common-sense level of moderation that all citizens agree on, and crossing that line causes harm to others and the community." (이 대통령은 모두 발언에서 사회적 ‘금도(넘지 말아야 할 선)’를 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “사회 공동체가 제대로 잘 작동하기 위해서는 적정한 선을 잘 지켜야 한다”며 “꼭 법률이 정하지 않았지만 상식적으로 우리 국민 모두가 동의하는 적절한 정도의 선이 있으며, 이 선을 넘어서면 타인과 공동체에 피해가 발생한다”고 포문을 열었다.)

He specifically pointed out the essence of the three labor rights guaranteed by the constitution and criticized the abuse of collective action rights. The President stated, "The three labor rights are meant to protect socially disadvantaged workers, and they involve the very important principles of solidarity and responsibility," and "They were not created to give force to a few individuals to push through something collectively for their own interests alone." (특히 헌법이 보장한 노동 3권의 본질을 짚으며 단체행동권 남용을 지적했다. 이 대통령은 “노동 3권도 사회적 약자인 노동자들을 보호하기 위한 것이고, 거기에는 연대와 책임이라는 아주 중요한 원리가 작용한다”며 “오로지 개인 몇몇 사람의 이익만을 위해서 집단적으로 뭔가를 관철해 내는 무력을 준 것이 아니다”라고 했다.)

He added, "Enterprises have investors (shareholders) who bear the risk and loss; fair compensation for labor must be guaranteed; and creditors, consumers, and the ecosystem of related businesses must also be protected," emphasizing, "No one should unilaterally cross the line." (그러면서 “기업에는 위험과 손실을 부담한 투자자(주주)가 있고, 노동에 대해서는 정당한 노동의 대가가 보장되어야 하며, 채권자·소비자·연관 기업 생태계도 함께 보호되어야 한다”며 “누군가가 일방적으로 선을 넘지 않아야 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

The President directly criticized the contradictions in the profit-sharing method demanded by some unions. He drew the line by saying, "It's fine for some labor unions to strive to achieve their interests, but there must be an appropriate line," and "Distributing profits from operating income is something investors and shareholders do." (이 대통령은 일부 노조가 요구하는 이익 공유 방식의 모순점을 정면으로 비판했다. 이 대통령은 “일부 노동조합이 자신들의 이익을 관철하기 위해 노력하는 것은 좋은데 그것도 적정한 선이 있어야 한다”며 “영업이익에 대해서 이익을 배분받는 것은 투자자가, 주주가 하는 것”이라고 선을 그었다.)

He further criticized, "Especially, demanding a certain percentage of operating income be shared institutionally before even deducting taxes, which is the public's share, is something even investors cannot do," and "Investors receive dividends from net profit after taxes, but (some unions' demands) are, to me, somewhat incomprehensible." This is a critique that the union is trying to touch pre-tax profits, which are the public's portion. (특히 “국민 공동의 몫이라고 할 수 있는 세금도 떼기 전에 영업이익의 일정 비율을 제도적으로 나눠 갖는다는 것은 투자자도 할 수 없는 일”이라며 “투자자도 세금을 떼고 당기순이익에서 배당을 받는데, (일부 노조의 요구는) 저로서는 약간 이해가 되지 않는다”고 했다. 노조가 공공의 몫을 떼기 전인 세전 이익에 손을 대려 한다는 취지의 비판이다.)

The President remarked, "Currently, we are seeing a trend of extreme polarization in many areas of society, with a lack of middle ground," and "Many are crossing the line, but history proves that such 'extreme crossing of lines' may seem helpful or beneficial in the short term, but in the long run, it is never so and will eventually lead to losses." (이 대통령은 “지금 사회 많은 영역에서 상당히 극단화되는 현상이 벌어지고 있고 중간이 잘 없다”며 “선을 많이들 넘는데, 이러한 ‘선 넘는 극단화’는 당장은 도움이 되거나 이익이 될진 몰라도 길게 보면 결코 그렇지 못하고 결국 손실로 돌아올 것임을 역사가 증명한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Ultimately, the final responsibility for all these adjustments lies with the government," stating, "We must ensure that members of our society properly observe the appropriate line and enjoy their rights freely within it, but when the line is crossed, the government must fulfill its given responsibilities for the entire community." (그러면서 “결국 이 모든 조정의 최종 책임은 정부에 있다”며 “우리 사회 구성원들이 적정한 선을 잘 지키고 그 선 안에서 자유롭게 권리를 누리게 하되, 선을 넘을 때에는 사회 전체 공동체를 위해 주어진 책임을 다해야 한다”고 했다.)

In closing, the President advised, "Rights always come with duties, and authority comes with responsibility," and "Since there is yin and yang in everything in the world, let's think about how excess is worse than deficiency." (마지막으로 이 대통령은 “언제나 권리에는 의무가 따르고 권한에는 책임이 따른다”며 “세상 모든 일에는 전부 다 음양이 있는 만큼, 지나침은 모자람만 못하다는 점을 한번 생각해보자”고 당부했다.)

On the same day, Samsung Electronics' labor and management continued post-mediation at the Central Labor Relations Commission but failed to reach a final agreement. Consequently, the union will proceed with a general strike for 18 days starting from the 21st. In response, the presidential office stated, "We deeply regret the breakdown of the post-mediation at the Central Labor Relations Commission," and urged, "Even before the final deadline, considering the potential impact on the Korean economy, we ask for the best efforts to reach a labor-management agreement until the very end." (이날 삼성전자 노사는 중앙노동위원회에서 사후 조정을 이어 갔으나 최종 합의에 이르지 못했다. 이에 따라 노조는 21일부터 18일간 총파업을 진행하게 됐다. 이에 대해 청와대는 “중노위 사후 조정이 결렬된 것에 매우 유감이다”며 “최종 시한 전이라도 한국 경제에 미칠 우려를 고려해 마지막까지 노사 합의를 위해 최선을 다해주기 바란다”고 당부했다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "I Was Bullied by a Cheong Wa Dae Administrator...I Have Never Experienced Such Rudeness in 40 Years of Public Service" (이석연 “靑 행정관에 갑질당해...40년 공직에 이런 무례 처음”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "I Was Bullied by a Cheong Wa Dae Administrator...I Have Never Experienced Such Rudeness in 40 Years of Public Service" (이석연 “靑 행정관에 갑질당해...40년 공직에 이런 무례 처음”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chair of the Presidential Committee on National Integration, revealed on the 20th that he was bullied by an administrator at Cheong Wa Dae. He distributed evidence and a statement as a press release, claiming that an administrator from the Cheong Wa Dae Office of the Secretary for National Integration had bullied and excessively interfered with him, a deputy prime minister-level official. Chair Lee said, "In over 40 years of public service, I have never experienced such rudeness." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장이 20일 청와대의 한 행정관에게 갑질을 당했다고 폭로했다. 청와대 국민통합비서관실 소속 행정관이 부총리급인 이 위원장에게 갑질과 과도한 개입을 했다며 관련 증거 자료와 입장문을 보도자료로 배포한 것이다. 이 위원장은 “40년이 넘는 공직 생활 동안 이와 같은 무례한 사례를 경험한 적이 없다”고 했다.)

In a statement released that afternoon, Chair Lee said that after receiving a request from Cheong Wa Dae to submit essential data related to state tasks by the 17th, he submitted the relevant materials on the 14th, but subsequently suffered unfair pressure from Cheong Wa Dae. Chair Lee stated, "After sufficient internal discussions, I, with the approval of the chair, conveyed the matters to be reported to the president to the relevant senior secretary's office. Nevertheless, a farce unfolded where (Cheong Wa Dae) pressured staff until Sunday night because their demands—which were practically unacceptable—were not reflected." Chair Lee did not specify in the statement what the 'practically unacceptable demands' from Cheong Wa Dae were. (이 위원장은 이날 오후 배포한 입장문에서, 청와대로부터 지난 17일까지 국정 과제 관련 필수 자료를 제출하라는 요구를 받고 14일에 관련 자료를 제출했지만, 이후 청와대의 부당한 압박에 시달렸다고 했다. 이 위원장은 “충분한 내부 논의를 거친 뒤 위원장 승인 아래 대통령 보고 사항을 관련 수석실에 전달했다”며 “그럼에도 불구하고 (청와대가) 자신들이 요구하는, 사실상 수용하기 어려운 사안이 반영되지 않았다는 이유로 일요일 밤까지 직원들을 압박하는 촌극이 벌어졌다”고 했다. 이 위원장은 청와대가 요구한 ‘사실상 수용하기 어려운 사안’이 무엇인지는 입장문에 구체적으로 밝히지 않았다.)

Chair Lee also disclosed an email sent to him directly by the Cheong Wa Dae administrator. In the email, the administrator said to Chair Lee, "The deadline for submitting essential data related to state tasks requested by the presidential office is today (the 17th), but it is being delayed due to a lack of communication from the committee. This is a serious matter that could cause disruptions to future state administration and presidential briefings." (이 위원장은 청와대 행정관이 자신에게 직접 보낸 이메일도 공개했다. 이 행정관은 이 위원장에게 이메일로 “대통령실 요청 국정과제 관련 필수 자료의 제출 마감이 금일(17일)까지이나, 위원회 측의 소통 부재로 지연되고 있다”며 “이는 향후 국정 운영 및 대통령 보고에 차질을 빚을 수 있는 중대한 사안임을 엄중히 고지한다”고 했다.)

Chair Lee described it as "a virtually warning email sent by a Cheong Wa Dae administrator to a deputy prime minister-level chair," adding, "It is very regrettable that such communication occurs at Cheong Wa Dae, the pinnacle of power in the public service." He continued, "This kind of bullying and excessive interference is by no means desirable. I have requested Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik to accurately understand the circumstances of this situation and take appropriate measures." (이 위원장은 “청와대 행정관이 부총리급 위원장에게 보낸 사실상의 경고성 메일”이라며 “공직 사회의 최고 권부인 청와대에서 이러한 방식의 소통이 이뤄진다는 것은 매우 유감스러운 일”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이러한 방식의 갑질과 과도한 개입은 결코 바람직하지 않다”며 “강훈식 비서실장에게 이번 상황의 경위를 정확히 파악하고 적절한 조치를 취해줄 것을 요청했다”고 했다.)

Chair Lee also said, "I cannot help but feel sorrow at the reality where, recently, there have been repeated moves to meddle in the affairs of the National Integration Committee and myself on every issue and to apply unnecessary brakes." According to the National Integration Committee and ruling party officials, there have been ongoing conflicts, both large and small, between Cheong Wa Dae and the committee. (이 위원장은 “최근 들어 사사건건 국민통합위와 위원장 본인의 행보에 관여하고, 불필요한 제동을 걸려는 움직임이 반복되고 있는 현실에 서러움을 금할 수 없다”고도 했다. 국민통합위와 여권 관계자들에 따르면, 청와대와 국민통합위 사이에 그동안 크고 작은 갈등이 끊이지 않았다고 한다.)

Chair Lee, who previously served as Minister of Government Legislation under the Lee Myung-bak administration and was mainly active in the conservative camp, was recruited as co-chair of the joint election campaign committee by President Lee during the last presidential election. After being appointed as chair of the National Integration Committee, he has continued to offer sharp criticism, such as denouncing the ruling party's push for a law on distortion of law as "an unconstitutional idea and a disgrace to a civilized nation." A ruling party official said, "I understand that because Chair Lee is so harsh in his criticism, there have even been comments within Cheong Wa Dae wondering if he is going too far." (이 위원장은 이명박 정부에서 법제처장을 지내는 등 주로 보수 진영에서 활동하다가, 지난 대선 때 이 대통령에 의해 공동선거대책위원장으로 영입됐는데, 국민통합위원장에 임명된 뒤 여권이 추진하는 법왜곡죄에 대해 “위헌적 발상이자 문명국의 수치”라고 비판하는 등 쓴소리를 이어왔다. 여권 관계자는 “이 위원장이 워낙 세게 비판을 하니까 청와대 안에서도 ‘너무하지 않나’ 하는 말들이 나온 것으로 안다”고 했다.)

item.title: Chaos in Pyeongtaek, Conservative Merger Whispered… People Power’s Yoo Ui-dong Says “Seriously Considering” (혼돈의 평택, 보수 단일화 꿈틀… 국힘 유의동 “진지한 고민”)
item.description:
Chaos in Pyeongtaek, Conservative Merger Whispered… People Power’s Yoo Ui-dong Says “Seriously Considering” (혼돈의 평택, 보수 단일화 꿈틀… 국힘 유의동 “진지한 고민”)

Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate for the Pyeongtaek B by-election, said on the 20th that he is “seriously considering” a conservative merger. This marks the first time Yoo has hinted at the possibility of merging with Hwang Kyo-ahn, the Liberty and Innovation Party candidate also running in Pyeongtaek B. The Pyeongtaek B by-election features a five-way race, including Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong, Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Cho Kuk, Liberty and Innovation Party candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn, and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon. <<> Appearing on YTN Radio today, Yoo responded to questions about a conservative merger, saying, “We cannot realistically ignore the demands of local residents.” He added, “There is public opinion among supporters that Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, who is embroiled in allegations of abusive behavior and assault, and Cho Kuk, who has a history of academic corruption, should not represent our district. We often hear people say, ‘Shouldn’t we unite the conservative voice?’ and it’s true that we are raising the level of serious consideration on this matter.” This leaves the door open for a potential merger with Hwang. <<> Regarding Hwang’s belief in election fraud conspiracy theories, Yoo acknowledged, “There are clear differences within the conservative camp,” but added, “The gap with Hwang is not as wide as with the Democratic Party or the Rebuilding Korea Party.” He emphasized, “We are taking the demands of local residents very seriously.” Earlier, Hwang also told this newspaper in a phone interview, “I will do everything possible for the right to win,” and noted, “When I was the leader of the former Liberty Korea Party, I also spearheaded a grand conservative integration.” <<> The multi-party race in the Pyeongtaek B by-election has made candidate mergers a late-stage variable that could determine the outcome. Recent polls show support rates among candidates are so close that no one can confidently predict victory. <<> In a wireless telephone survey of 500 voters in the Pyeongtaek B district conducted on the 16th–17th by Chosun Ilbo in partnership with Matrix, Cho Kuk received 26% support, Kim Yong-nam 25%, and Yoo Ui-dong 20%. The top three candidates are all within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Liberty and Innovation Party candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn followed with 11%, and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon with 6%. Another 12% said they had no preferred candidate, were unsure, or did not respond. <<> Tensions are escalating over a potential progressive merger. Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam said on CBS Radio today, “As things stand, the possibility of a merger is very slim,” adding, “For a candidate merger to happen, a sense of solidarity must be built, but in this election, the Rebuilding Korea Party has shown an outdated election culture.” When the host asked, “Does that mean even if your party strongly urges a merger, you don’t intend to accept it?” Kim replied, “Yes.” <<> On the same day, Cho Kuk proposed a joint policy announcement at a press conference at the National Assembly, targeting Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon. Cho stated, “I, Cho Kuk, will take the lead to ensure that the solidarity and integration of the democratic reform camp proceed in a predictable, orderly, and stable manner.” Regarding a conservative merger, he said, “In the current situation, the likelihood of a merger between Yoo Ui-dong and Liberty and Innovation’s Hwang Kyo-ahn is increasingly shrinking,” but added, “If such a scenario occurs and Yoo ends up taking first place in the polls, we must follow the people’s mandate.” (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 국민의힘 유의동 후보가 20일 보수진영 단일화와 관련해서 “진지하게 고민하고 있다”고 말했다. 유 후보가 평택을에 출마한 자유와혁신 황교안 후보와의 단일화 가능성을 시사한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에는 더불어민주당 김용남 후보, 국민의힘 유의동 후보, 조국혁신당 조국 후보, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보, 진보당 김재연 후보가 5자 구도로 경쟁하고 있다.)

item.title: Lee: "Israel's detention of Koreans goes too far... Should consider an arrest warrant for Netanyahu" (李 “이스라엘, 한국인 나포 도넘어... 네타냐후 체포영장 검토해야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Israel's detention of Koreans goes too far... Should consider an arrest warrant for Netanyahu" (李 “이스라엘, 한국인 나포 도넘어... 네타냐후 체포영장 검토해야”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 20th strongly criticized the detention of Koreans aboard an international aid ship headed to Gaza by Israeli forces, stating, "It is terribly inhumane and absolutely excessive." Regarding Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, he also said, "Isn't he recognized as a war criminal by the International Criminal Court (ICC) and subject to an arrest warrant?" proposing that if Netanyahu enters Korea, measures to arrest him should be considered. (이재명 대통령은 20일 가자지구로 향하던 국제 구호선에 탑승한 한국인들이 이스라엘군에 억류된 것에 대해 “너무 비인도적이고 도가 지나쳐도 너무 지나치다”며 강하게 비판했다. 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리에 대해서도 “국제형사재판소(ICC) 전범으로 인정돼 체포 영장이 발부돼 있는 것 아니냐”며 네타냐후 총리가 한국으로 들어올 경우 체포하는 방안을 검토하자고 했다.)

During a cabinet meeting that day, President Lee inquired about the incident in which an international aid ship headed to Gaza was seized by Israeli forces, leading to the successive detention of Korean activists on board. According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, following the aid ship carrying Kim Dong-hyun on the 18th, another ship carrying Kim Ah-hyun was also seized by Israeli forces early on the 20th, resulting in two Korean activists being detained. (이 대통령은 이날 국무회의에서 가자지구로 향하던 국제 구호선이 이스라엘군에 나포되면서 탑승하고 있던 한국인 활동가들이 잇따라 억류된 사건에 대해 물었다. 외교부에 따르면, 지난 18일 김동현씨가 탄 구호선에 이어, 20일 새벽 김아현씨가 탄 구호선 역시 이스라엘군에 나포되면서 한국인 활동가 2명이 억류된 상황이다.)

President Lee said, "I hear that Israel is seizing or sinking ships, including those carrying our citizens who want to volunteer in Gaza. What is the legal basis for this?" He added, "Isn't this an illegal invasion and aggression by Israel under international law?" In response, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said, "That part needs to be examined," adding, "The situation began when Hamas attacked Israel, killing nearly 2,000 people, which prompted Israel to impose military control over the region." (이 대통령은 “이스라엘이 가자지구에 자원봉사하러 가겠다고 하는 우리 내국인을 포함한 선박을 나포하거나 폭침시키고 있다고 하는데, 법적 근거가 뭐냐”며 “국제법적으로 (이스라엘이 가자지구를) 불법 침범, 침략한 거 아니냐”고 했다. 이에 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 “그 부분은 따져봐야 한다”며 “시작은 하마스가 이스라엘을 공격해 2000명 가까운 사람을 살상한 것으로부터 촉발했기 때문에, 이스라엘이 그 지역을 향해 군사 통제를 가하고 있는 상황”이라고 했다.)

President Lee repeatedly questioned whether Gaza is Israeli territory. When he asked, "Is it their land? Is it Israeli territorial waters?" Director Wi replied, "It is not Israeli territory." President Lee then said, "Then shouldn't we protest? Can you seize a third-country ship during combat? This goes beyond laws and basic common sense—isn't this also an issue of boundaries?" (이 대통령은 가자지구가 이스라엘 영토가 맞느냐고 여러 차례 언급했다. 이 대통령이 “지 땅입니까? 이스라엘 영해에요?”라고 하자, 위 실장은 “이스라엘 영토는 아니다”라고 답했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “그러면 항의해야 하는 것 아니냐”라며 “교전 중이면 제3국 선박을 나포해도 되냐. 법이고 자시고 기본적인 상식이 있는 것인데, 이것도 역시 선에 관한 문제 아니냐”고 했다.)

Director Wi said, "It's somewhat complicated regarding those individuals," noting, "Last time, we told them that Gaza is a restricted entry area and not to enter, but they entered anyway." In response, President Lee said, "Disregarding government policy and recommendations is an internal matter for us, but isn't it wrong to detain our citizens for reasons not justified under international law? In my view, this is too severe and inhumane." (위 실장이 “그 분들에 대해서는 좀 복잡하다”며 “지난번에도 저희가 가자지역은 입국 금지 지역이니 입국하지 말라고 했는데 입국을 한 것”이라고 했다. 그러자 이 대통령은 “정부 방침, 권고를 안 따른 거은 우리 내부의 문제고, 우리 국민을 국제법적으로 타당하지 않은 사유로 잡아간 건 맞지 않느냐”며 “제가 보기엔 너무 심하고, 비인도적이다”라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "As far as I can see, most European countries have issued arrest warrants for Prime Minister Netanyahu and announced they would arrest him if he enters their territory. I see many are doing so, so let's make a judgment too." He added, "There are minimum international norms, but they are being violated. Act according to principles—we have endured too much already." (이 대통령은 “아무리 봐도 지금 유럽의 거의 대부분의 국가들이 (네타냐후 총리에 대한) 체포영장 발부해서 자기 국내로 들어오면 체포하겠다고 발표했다”며 “제가 보니까 상당히 많던데 우리도 판단을 해보자”고 했다. 그러면서 “최소한의 국제규범이라고 하는 게 있는 건데, 그걸 다 어기고 있다”며 “원칙대로 하라, 그동안 너무 많이 인내를 했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Busan North Gap in Turmoil… Han Dong-hoon Takes First Place in Three-Way Race (부산 북갑 요동… 한동훈, 3자 대결 첫 1위)
item.description:
In a survey conducted by Research & Research for Channel A from the 17th to the 19th on the Busan North Gap parliamentary by-election, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo received 32.9%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik received 20.5%, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon received 34.6%. In the three-way race, the gap in approval between Han Dong-hoon and Ha Jung-woo stood at 1.7 percentage points (p), within the margin of error (±4.4%p). (여론조사 회사 리서치앤리서치가 채널A 의뢰로 지난 17~19일 실시한 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 지지도 조사에서 더불어민주당 하정우 후보는 32.9%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 20.5%, 무소속 한동훈 후보는 34.6%로 나타났다. 3자 구도에서 한동훈·하정우 후보의 지지도 격차는 1.7%포인트(p)로 오차 범위(±4.4%p) 안이었다.)

In hypothetical two-way matchups assuming conservative unification, Ha Jung-woo had 42.6% vs. Park Min-shik's 32.4%, and Ha Jung-woo had 37.6% vs. Han Dong-hoon's 44.1%. This survey was conducted via wireless phone interviews targeting 500 voters in the Busan North Gap district. (보수 단일화를 전제로 한 가상 양자 대결에서는 하정우 후보 42.6% 대 박민식 후보 32.4%, 하정우 후보 37.6% 대 한동훈 후보 44.1%였다. 이번 조사는 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 500명을 대상으로 무선 전화면접 방식으로 실시됐다.)

Earlier, a wireless phone interview survey by Matrix for Chosun Ilbo on the 16th and 17th targeting 501 Busan North Gap voters showed Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo at 39%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik at 20%, and independent Han Dong-hoon at 33%. Another survey by Korea Research for MBC on the 16th to 18th targeting 500 Busan North Gap voters also recorded Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo at 38%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik at 20%, and independent Han Dong-hoon at 33%. <<> Regarding the 'two strong, one moderate' structure, some within the People Power Party suggest that once the official campaign period begins on the 21st, Park, receiving party support, could close the gap. Both Park Min-shik and Han Dong-hoon are negative about artificial unification, but a conservative insider said, “If conservative unification happens, the ripple effects could impact the entire Yeongnam region election, so we are monitoring it closely.” (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission) (앞서 조선일보 의뢰로 메트릭스가 지난 16~17일 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 501명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 민주당 하정우 후보 39%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보 20%, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 33%의 지지도를 얻었다. 코리아리서치가 MBC 의뢰로 지난 16~18일 부산 북갑 유권자 500명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서도 민주당 하정우 후보 38%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보 20%, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 33%를 기록했다.)

item.title: Will the Opposition Sweep All 5 Seats in Chungcheong and Gangwon, or Will the Ruling Party Defend South Chungcheong? (충청·강원 5곳, 與 싹쓸이냐 野 충남 방어냐)
item.description:
In the elections for metropolitan mayors and governors in the Chungcheong and Gangwon regions (5 seats), the key question is whether the Democratic Party of Korea will sweep all seats or the People Power Party will defend some areas. In the 2018 local elections, the Democratic Party took all five, while in the 2022 local elections, the People Power Party swept them. Current polls show the Democratic Party leading in all five, but factors such as the narrowing gap for some People Power Party candidates and the undecided vote could become variables. On the first day of official campaigning, the 21st, both party leaders are visiting Chungcheong, a traditional swing region. <<> In the South Chungcheong governor election, the race is tightening, with People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum closing in on Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun. A poll conducted by Korea Research, Daejeon MBC, and Chungcheong Today on the 16th-17th showed Park at 44% and Kim at 37%, an 8 percentage point difference, within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). In a Korea Research poll from the 26th-28th of last month, Park led 44% to 23%, a 21-point gap, but the margin has shrunk. The undecided vote was estimated at 19% in the Korea Research survey, leading to speculation that late-stage undecided voters could sway the outcome. <<> In the North Chungcheong governor election, a poll by K-Stat Research and KBS Cheongju on the 13th-15th showed Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han at 37% and People Power Party candidate Kim Young-hwan at 25%, a 12-point gap. However, the undecided vote was 35%. Considering that undecided voters in other regions hover around 20%, North Chungcheong is seen as having the most significant undecided variable. <<> The Daejeon and Sejong mayoral elections show strong Democratic Party momentum. In a Korea Research, Daejeon MBC, and Chungcheong Today poll on the 16th-17th, Democratic Party candidate Heo Tae-jeong led in Daejeon with 51% against People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo's 29%, while in Sejong, Democratic Party candidate Cho Sang-ho had 51% over People Power Party candidate Choi Min-ho's 24%. <<> In the Gangwon governor election, a Korea Research and KBS Chuncheon poll on the 11th-14th showed Democratic Party candidate Woo Sang-ho at 44.8% and People Power Party candidate Kim Jin-tae at 32.7%, a 12.1-point gap. However, with undecided voters at 20.8%, Gangwon is also expected to have an undecided vote factor. (충청·강원 광역 단체장 선거(5곳)에서 더불어민주당이 모두 석권할지, 국민의힘이 일부 지역을 방어할지가 관심사다. 지난 2018년 지방선거는 민주당, 2022년 지방선거는 국민의힘이 5곳을 모두 가져갔다. 현재 여론조사상 5곳 모두 민주당 우세인 가운데, 일부 지역 국민의힘 후보의 추격 흐름과 부동층 표심 등이 변수가 될 전망이다. 여야 당 대표 모두 공식 선거 운동 첫날인 21일 전통적인 스윙 보터 지역인 충청을 찾는다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: "Seoul's Rental Crisis Due to Oh"; Oh Se-hoon: "Democratic Party Mayor is Main Cause of Housing Crisis" (정원오 “吳 탓에 전월세난”… 오세훈 “민주당 시장이 주거난 주범”)
item.description:
In the Seoul mayoral election, the biggest battleground of the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition parties are locked in a tight race, while in the Gyeonggi governor and Incheon mayor elections, the ruling party holds an advantage over the opposition. (6·3 지방선거의 최대 승부처인 서울시장 선거에서 여야가 접전을 벌이는 가운데, 경기지사와 인천시장 선거에선 여당이 야당에 우위를 점하고 있다.)

In a mobile phone interview survey commissioned by Channel A and conducted by Research & Research from the 17th to the 19th, Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh received 43.9% and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon received 35.7%, with Jeong leading outside the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). In contrast, a mobile phone interview survey commissioned by the Chosun Ilbo and conducted by Matrix on the 16th and 17th showed Jeong Won-oh at 40% and Oh Se-hoon at 37%, with the gap within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). <<> As the double-digit gap from the early stages of the election narrows, a sense of crisis is rising within the Democratic Party. Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said today, "The Seoul mayoral election is unfolding fiercely as expected," adding, "We will make our best efforts by pooling all the party's manpower and resources for victory." <<> Candidates Jeong and Oh each attended the two sessions of the Gwanhun Club debates held this morning. Though they did not face each other in person, they exchanged sharp remarks on issues such as real estate. Candidate Jeong said, "If Oh Se-hoon had kept his promises during his tenure as Seoul mayor, there would have been no jeonse and monthly rent housing crisis," adding, "Oh promised to supply 360,000 housing units within five years during the 2021 local election, but only about 39,000 units were supplied each year from 2022 to 2024." In response, Candidate Oh countered, "Former Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon (from the Democratic Party) lifted development restrictions on 389 redevelopment and reconstruction zones.
